columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Time the policy change was made, derived from the Airlock datetime field

columns.name: Checkpoint
columns.description: Event checkpoint identifier for incremental retrieval

columns.name: EventDateTime
columns.description: Timestamp of the policy change event

columns.name: PolicyGroup
columns.description: Name of the policy group that was changed, for example Workstations Audit

columns.name: PolicyVersion
columns.description: Policy version after the change, for example 4646.3818

columns.name: PolicyId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the policy group that was changed

columns.name: User
columns.description: User account that made the policy change

columns.name: Uuid
columns.description: Unique identifier of this policy change record

columns.name: ChangeDescription
columns.description: Summary of the change, for example User Updated Group

columns.name: UserReason
columns.description: Free-text reason entered by the user when saving the change

columns.name: SettingsChanges
columns.description: Policy setting edits; array of objects with field, operation, old_value and value; null when unchanged

columns.name: PublisherChanges
columns.description: Publisher rules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: PathChanges
columns.description: Path rules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: ParentProcessChanges
columns.description: Parent process rules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: GrandparentProcessChanges
columns.description: Grandparent process rules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: AllowlistChanges
columns.description: Allowlists added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, name, timestamp, tag and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: BaselineChanges
columns.description: Baselines added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, name, timestamp, tag and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: BlocklistChanges
columns.description: Blocklists added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, name, timestamp, tag and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: HashChanges
columns.description: File hash rules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: MetaruleChanges
columns.description: Metarules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: ExtensionChanges
columns.description: Browser extension rules added or removed; array of objects with type, operation, value and inherited; null when unchanged

columns.name: ConnectorName
columns.description: Connector Friendly Name assigned during connector setup
